answer: In the AGILE Index 2025, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) that receive the most AI research attention are SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-Being), SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities), and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure). High-income countries allocate higher AI research attention to social-level SDGs, while upper-middle and lower-middle income countries have relatively higher AI research attention to economically and environmentally related SDGs.
